core_obligations: Let P be the property that the formula of the lemma holds for F and observe that the assumptions of the coherent-sheaf criterion are to be verified (proof lines 9681-9684).
Verify additivity of P in short exact sequences: both the Euler characteristic and the rank r are additive (proof lines 9685-9686).

Verify the criterion's test cases: for Z = X take G = O_X, where P holds by the definition of the degree, and for a closed point take G = i_*O_Z, where P holds by the finite-support lemma with r = 0 (proof lines 9687-9692).
proof_roadmap: Formulate the formula as a property of coherent sheaves.
Check additivity of the property from additivity of chi and of rank.
Check the property on the structure sheaf and on a closed point.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves chi(X, E tensor F) = r deg(E) + n chi(X, F) for a locally free E of rank n and a coherent F of rank r on a proper curve. The proof applies the general criterion for a property of coherent sheaves to hold on all of them: it verifies that the property P(F) expressed by the formula is additive in short exact sequences, because both the Euler characteristic and the rank are additive, and that it holds for the two test sheaves required by the criterion, namely O_X (where it is the definition of the degree) and i_*O_Z for a closed point (where r = 0 and the claim reduces to the finite support lemma) (proof lines 9681-9692). H2: setting up the property and verifying the two test cases of the criterion is the substance.
